about: [O6b critic] the main verbs' latency on the bed (page clock, key press to the first frame that shows it): E at the coupe -> in the seat; W -> the car moving; then a ram: W into the sedan ahead -> the first frame its damage shows (a part loose or a dent).

steps.eval: (() => { const W = window.__lat = { down: null, first: null, frames: 0 }; const test = window.__test; addEventListener('keydown', () => { if (W.down == null) W.down = performance.now(); }, { capture: true, once: true }); const tick = () => { if (W.down != null) { W.frames++; if (W.first == null && test()) W.first = performance.now(); } if (W.first == null && W.frames < 120) requestAnimationFrame(tick); }; requestAnimationFrame(tick); return 1; })()
(() => { const W = window.__lat; return JSON.stringify({ ms: W.first != null ? +(W.first - W.down).toFixed(1) : null, frames: W.frames }); })()
